tv.note: On ESPN Unlimited (comes with YouTube TV)

news.headline: Jackson Courville is up for a scholar award
news.summary: Tulane kicker Jackson Courville is one of 206 semifinalists for the Campbell Trophy. It goes to the college football player who does the best job in class, on the field and as a leader.

news.headline: William Hudlow named one of the week's best punters
news.summary: Tulane punter William Hudlow made the Ray Guy Award's weekly list of the eight best punters in the country. He punted five times for 203 yards at Kansas State, and his longest went 51 yards.

news.headline: Cooper Helmke sets the Tulane field goal record
news.summary: Helmke's 58-yard kick at Kansas State on Saturday is the longest in school history, one yard past the mark Cairo Santos set in 2012. The redshirt freshman missed all of last season with a back injury and a hip injury.

news.headline: Florida's game with Ole Miss is sold out
news.summary: Every ticket is gone for Saturday afternoon's game in Gainesville. It is the 21st home game in a row that Florida has sold out.

news.headline: Eric Singleton might play Saturday against Ole Miss
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said Monday that the receiver did more in practice than he has done since he hurt his ankle on September 5. Sumrall said they will warm Singleton up Saturday and play him if he is ready.

news.headline: Florida is ranked for the first time under Sumrall
news.summary: The Gators are No. 21 in the new Associated Press Top 25, which came out Sunday, after their 44-39 win at Auburn. It is the first time Florida has been ranked since Jon Sumrall became the coach.

news.headline: College GameDay is going to Knoxville
news.summary: ESPN's Saturday morning show will come from Tennessee's campus before Texas plays there at 11:00 AM. Both teams have won all three of their games.

news.headline: Sarkisian tells Arch Manning to be himself
news.summary: Coach Steve Sarkisian said Monday that Manning ran with the ball too often in Saturday's win and should pick his spots better. He also said he does not want Manning trying to play like Peyton, Eli or Archie: “Arch Manning is plenty good enough for us to put us in position to win.”

news.headline: Colin Simmons leaves the UTSA game in a boot
news.summary: Texas pass rusher Colin Simmons sat out the second half of Saturday's win and watched from the sideline in a walking boot. Coach Steve Sarkisian said taking him out was a precaution and that he expects Simmons back for Saturday's game at Tennessee.

news.headline: Kelvin Banks is placed on injured reserve
news.summary: The Saints moved their starting left tackle to injured reserve on Wednesday. He hurt his ankle in Sunday's win at Baltimore and has to miss at least the next four games.

news.headline: Three Saints sit out Wednesday's practice
news.summary: Barion Brown, Martin Emerson and Christen Miller all missed practice Wednesday with injuries. Travis Etienne and Chase Young were on the field but did only part of the work.

news.headline: Asim Richards takes over at left tackle
news.summary: Richards finished Sunday's win in Baltimore after Kelvin Banks hurt his ankle, and coach Kellen Moore said he held his own against the Ravens' best pass rusher. Moore said Richards will take as many practice snaps as he can this week.

tv.name: the PSAC Sports Digital Network app
tv.note: Every IUP volleyball match is on the PSAC Sports Digital Network. On game day, tap this link, or open the free PSAC Sports Digital Network app on a phone, tablet, Roku or Apple TV.

news.headline: IUP sweeps Seton Hill in conference opener
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks won 25-23, 25-22, 25-17 at Seton Hill on Friday in their first conference match of the year. Delaney Concannon and Kyra Schmidt each had 8 kills, and IUP is 9-3 and has not lost since August 29.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher has her best day of the season
news.summary: Peyton had 8 kills in Friday's win over Millersville, more than anyone else on the team. It is the most she has had in a match this year, and she missed on only one of her 14 swings.

news.headline: IUP wins twice in West Virginia
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks beat Shepherd and then Millersville on Friday and did not lose a set in either match. IUP has now won seven in a row and is 8-3.

tv.note: Not on YouTube TV — this one streams on Amazon Prime Video.

news.headline: Yankees will host a playoff series next week
news.summary: New York finished as the top wild card team in the American League, so the first playoff round starts at Yankee Stadium. Game one is Tuesday night.

news.headline: Rays beat the Yankees 6-1 and win the division
news.summary: Tampa Bay won Tuesday night's game at Yankee Stadium and finished first in the American League East. The Yankees had taken the afternoon game of the doubleheader 2-0.

news.headline: Yankees shut out the Rays 2-0
news.summary: Carlos Rodon pitched eight scoreless innings Tuesday afternoon and Cody Bellinger hit a two-run home run. It was the first game of a doubleheader, and the Rays came back to win the night game.

news.headline: Warren Easton falls to Brother Martin
news.summary: Brother Martin scored early and often Friday night and won 56-6. Warren Easton is 0-3 and plays at Zachary next Friday.
